description: Check whether a directory listing page links to your site and whether that link is followed. Reads the page's static HTML and reports every anchor pointing at your domain with its rel (nofollow, ugc, sponsored), hidden links, links that only go through the directory's own redirect, and page-level noindex, nofollow and canonical. Use it after submitting to directories to see which listings went live and which ones pass a dofollow link.

page_url.description: The directory page that lists your product, e.g. "https://somedirectory.com/tools/your-product"

your_domain.description: Your product's domain or any URL on it, e.g. "example.com". Subdomains count as matches.

name: check_backlink

canonicalElsewhere.description: The canonical URL when it differs from the page

linkCount.description: Direct links found; links lists the first 20

followed.description: No nofollow, ugc or sponsored on the anchor

hidden.description: Hidden by its own hidden attribute or inline style

pageIndexable.description: False when the page says noindex

pageNofollow.description: Meta robots or X-Robots-Tag nofollow: no link on the page is followed

redirectLinkCount.description: Links that reach your domain only through the directory's redirect

truncated.description: The HTML was over 2 MB and read only up to that point

verdict.description: not_found covers listings drawn by JavaScript: the check reads static HTML only

title: Check a directory backlink
